exact_statement: For k >= 3, let F_k(n) be the minimum number of colours needed to colour an n-vertex graph with floor(n^2/4)+1 edges so that every C_(2k+1) is rainbow. For k=3, prove or refute that F_3(n) is asymptotic to n^2/8.
scope_notes: The public statement, source, sole success condition, and all non-success conditions are copied exactly from erdos-809-conversion-round3; that campaign remains frozen and read-only.
Round four inherits only the independently audited exact integer-rounding reduction, typed Hall boundary, and negative carrier evidence. It does not inherit any actual carrier-creation theorem.

A carrier is actual only when it is a concrete missing B-edge in the original graph and a legal arc is derived from that graph's canonical reserve or an explicitly proved graph operation. Universal dummy carriers are comparison objects only.
No conditional Hall reduction, finite absence of counterexamples, or the previously conjectured coefficient 1/8 counts as promotion.
